results.title: Thane Cluster Development Company Proposal Passed Amid BJP Opposition, Deepening Rift Within Ruling Alliance
results.description: Thane Municipal Corporation’s General Body meeting saw political tension as Shiv Sena passed a proposal to form the ‘Thane Cluster Development Company’ despite objections from BJP and opposition parties on Monday. BJP corporators questioned transparency and governance details of the SPV, while officials said the entity would streamline execution of cluster development projects and generate revenue

results.title: Ahmedabad: Students take part in satellitemodel making contest
results.description: 16 school teams from classes 9–12 joined VASCSC and SAC-ISRO’s Satellite Model Making Challenge in Ahmedabad ahead of National Space Day, showcasing conceptual and semi-functional designs.
